description: This file defines the Subtotal class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for calculating various subtotal functions in spreadsheet cells, including handling hidden rows and formulas.

classes.name: Subtotal
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate subtotal functions in spreadsheets, considering hidden rows and formulas.

methods.name: filterHiddenArgs
methods.description: Filters arguments based on whether the associated rows are hidden in the worksheet.

methods.name: filterFormulaArgs
methods.description: Filters arguments by excluding cells containing SUBTOTAL or AGGREGATE formulas.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Main method to compute the subtotal based on function type and input arguments.
